status: post hoc and exploratory; criteria in criteria.json were written before computing; changes no preregistered decision

criteria.designs: the real (y, drug, partner) structure of Novel and Older-clean, tiers A and B
criteria.scorer: s = beta_d * y + sigma_p * u_partner + sigma_d * v_drug + e, u, v, e standard normal, beta_d = beta + tau * z_d; the true within-drug AUROC is Phi(beta / sqrt(2 (sigma_p^2 + 1) + tau^2)) because a drug's positives and negatives never share a partner; sigma_d = 1
criteria.scenarios: true AUROC in {0.45, 0.50, 0.60} x sigma_p in {0, 1} x tau in {0, 0.5}: 12 per design
criteria.reps: 1,000 replicates per scenario and design (at least 500 as required), 1,000 bootstrap draws per replicate, simulation seed 7
criteria.primary_statistic: empirical coverage of the nominal 90% percentile interval against the analytic true value, per bootstrap (two-way, one-way drug, partner only); also 95% coverage, mean 90% half-width, the ratio of that half-width to 1.645 times the replicate SD, and the share of replicates with the 90% interval inside [0.40, 0.60]
criteria.calibrated: 90% coverage in [0.87, 0.93] and half-width ratio in [0.85, 1.15]
criteria.conservative: 90% coverage above 0.93 or half-width ratio above 1.15, with coverage at least 0.87
criteria.adequate_bootstrap_on_a_design: no scenario on that design is anti-conservative
